ranked_findings.title: NSAID in heart failure
ranked_findings.summary: Naproxen (NSAID) is on the confirmed medicine list of a patient with heart failure.
ranked_findings.patient_question: I was given Naproxen for pain. Is it safe with my heart failure, and is there a safer option?
ranked_findings.clinician_note: NSAIDs can cause sodium/fluid retention, worsen HF and kidney function, and blunt diuretics.

rules_evaluated.detail: No potassium salt substitute logged in the D015 window.
No active DPP-4 inhibitor linked to HF hospitalization.
Threshold undefined: 'rise vs baseline (define % with clinician)'.
